installera.hint: Run `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt install git`.

identitet.text: Tell git who you are: set your name (`user.name`) and your email address (`user.email`) with `git config --global`.
identitet.hint: Two commands: `git config --global user.name "Your Name"` and `git config --global user.email "you@example.com"`.

init.text: Go to the directory `~/{{webProject}}` and turn it into a git repository with `git init`.
init.hint: `cd ~/{{webProject}}` and then `git init`. Have a look at the new hidden directory with `ls -a`.

forsta-commit.text: Add all three files to the index with `git add` and make your first commit with a descriptive message.
forsta-commit.hint: `git add .` adds everything in the directory. Then `git commit -m "{{commitFirst}}"`. Check the state with `git status` before and after!

diff.text: Add a line at the end of `README.md` and look at the change with `git diff`.
diff.hint: `echo '{{builtWith}}' >> README.md` and then `git diff`. Lines starting with `+` are new.

commit-a.text: Commit the change to `README.md`. Try the `-a` option, which includes every changed file git already follows.

gren.text: Create the branch `{{newDesign}}` and switch to it. Change something in `style.css` and commit the change on the new branch.
gren.hint: `git switch -c {{newDesign}}` creates the branch and switches to it. Then change the file, e.g. with `echo 'h1 { color: purple; }' >> style.css`, and run `git commit -am "{{commitPurple}}"`.

merge.text: Switch back to `main` and merge the branch `{{newDesign}}` with `git merge`.
merge.hint: `git switch main` and then `git merge {{newDesign}}`. Since `main` hasn't changed since you created the branch, this will be a *fast-forward*.

logg.text: Show the history with one line per commit using `git log --oneline`.
logg.hint: Also try `git log --oneline --graph --all` to see the branches.
